e08afe42545c5683.description:
We are looking for a highly analytical and proactive Product Analyst to partner closely with Product Managers across our payments business. This role goes beyond data extraction, you will translate data into actionable insights, proactively monitor product performance, and help shape product decisions that drive growth.
What You’ll Do
1. Product Analytics & Insights
● Analyze large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights for product teams
● Translate business questions into analytical frameworks and measurable metrics
● Identify opportunities to improve conversion, success rates, and user experience
2. Metrics Ownership & Monitoring
● Define, track, and monitor key product KPIs (e.g., payment success rates, drop-offs, latency, adoption)
● Build dashboards and automated reports to provide real-time visibility to stakeholders
● Proactively flag anomalies, performance drops, and emerging trends
3. Partner with Product & Engineering
● Work closely with Product Managers to evaluate new features, experiments, and product changes
● Support planning, testing, and post-launch analysis of product initiatives
● Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data availability and accuracy
4. Experimentation & Decision Support
● Design and analyze A/B tests and experiments
● Provide data-backed recommendations for product strategy and prioritization
● Evaluate impact of product changes and suggest next steps
5. Data Modeling & Deep Dives
● Perform deep-dive analyses on funnels, cohorts, and user behavior
● Build scalable SQL queries and data models for repeatable insights
● Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions
What We’re Looking For
Experience
● 1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst / Product Analyst / Data Analyst
● Experience in fintech/payments is a plus, not mandatory
Core Skills
● Strong SQL skills (must-have), ability to work with large datasets independently
● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
● Experience with Excel / Google Sheets; familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.) is a plus
● Ability to convert data into clear, actionable insights
Mindset
● Proactive: doesn’t wait for asks, identifies problems/opportunities independently
● Curious: digs deep into “why” behind the numbers
● Structured thinker: can break down ambiguous problems into measurable components
● Good stakeholder communication skills
Good to Have
● Experience working with payment systems (cards, UPI, etc.)
● Exposure to experimentation frameworks (A/B testing)
● Basic knowledge of Python/R for data analysis
Why This Role Matters
This role sits at the intersection of product, data, and business impact. You will directly influence product decisions by:
● Improving conversion and success rates
● Identifying growth opportunities
● Enabling faster, data-driven decision making
Success in This Role Looks Like
● You proactively surface insights before PMs ask
● You become the go-to person for product metrics
● Your analysis directly influences roadmap and prioritization
● You help teams move from “data reporting” → “decision making”
